author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000264493  (PTHR12281)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel SCCRO (FBgn0036510), SCCRO3 (FBgn0033784) and SCCRO4 (FBgn0036967)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source?

https://pantree.org/node/annotationNode.jsp?id=PTN000264493 says that annotation to "NEDD8 transferase activity" is based on (HUMAN|HGNC=28409|UniProtKB=Q9BTE7;), but I don't see that source annotation in UniProt or Protein2GO.

Seems that Q9BTE7 (and its paralogs) are scaffolds/regulators of  NEDD8 transferases and not catalytic proteins themselves.

Maybe the source annotation was removed recently and this is just a sync-ing issue?
title: PAINT issue: PTN000264493  (PTHR12281)

author: marcfeuermann
body: That was a annotation made directly in PAINT. I've made the correction. I'm going to stop here for today. I've had a lot of complex adjustments to make, and my brain needs a break. I'll continue next week. Have a great weekend.

author: sjm41
body:
Hmmm, do annotations made directly in PAINT show up in P2GO or QuickGO/AmiGO at some point? I assumed they would.

Sorry for the barrage of tickets, but we're just making a new FB release and I found a bunch of wrong/suspect PAINT annotations, so wanted to report them. Please do take a break, and we can continue next week! Cheers!!

author: pgaudet
body:
Hi @sjm41 

The PAINT data needs a couple of months (on average) for the annotations to trickle through the pipeline.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hi @sjm41,
I’ve just seen that Pascale has already replied.
Please don’t worry about the “barrage of tickets”! It’s great that you’re identifying errors and helping us improve the quality of our annotations, so please keep them coming!
As you’ve probably noticed, I’m doing my best to make as much progress as possible. It’ll take as long as it takes, but we’ll get there! I’ll get back to your requests later this week, as I also have quite a long list of other UniProt requests to work through. ;-)
Best regards,
Marc

author: sjm41
body: Thanks both! Do you know what 4-letter code is assigned to direct annotations from you (Marc) in Protein2GO? I guess it's not REFG like the other IBA annotations?

author: sjm41
body: Ah, I thought there might be a special PAINT/Marc code, but SWIS makes sense! Thanks.

author: pgaudet
body: Ohhh apologies. In fact I dont know if they are even loaded in P2GO. @marcfeuermann can you give the ID of a gene you have annotated so we can check? I will follow up with Alex and Vinicius.

author: marcfeuermann
body:
Hello,
This is a good question. From what I understood, they are not loaded in P2GO, but in quickGO and AmiGO. I cannot tell you what the signature is.
I will try to find an older annotation made by PAINT and see where it appears.
Cheers,
Marc.
